author: Independent delegated reviewer /root/profile_review
conditions: Run matching clean frozen source commit and exact file hashes. The independently authored review packet may be committed separately without changing the reviewed files.
Use reviewed immutable retained generation-D image/archive, fresh short disposable path and current protected roots/cgroups; retain independently checked preflight and postflight inventories.

Serialize against all evaluations and maintenance. Execute once with wrapper command timeout 900 seconds and outer systemd runtime limit 1200 seconds; preserve partial evidence and perform explicit terminal reconciliation if outer interruption prevents driver finalization.

findings: Callback uses exactly control then profile with fixed repository-owned empty solver and locally generated tiny public input; any failed command or assertion aborts without retry.

All Docker commands use the registered fresh dedicated endpoint. Explicit sandbox flags preserve network isolation, read-only root, unprivileged UID, capability drop, no-new-privileges, bounded resources and a read-only fixture mount.

docker create -i and start --attach --interactive receive payload through simultaneous nonblocking owned-client stdin/stdout/stderr capture. EOF is delivered after exact bounded payload; no polling attach race or sequential stream deadlock is introduced.

Per-start command deadline is 60 seconds; common capture caps each stream at 8 MiB, callback rejects above 1 MiB and retains ordinary raw streams privately. Exceptions retain bounded private command failure streams.

Native driver gates clean source/commit, aggregate digest, callback digest, private independent packet, exact delegated operator and pinned private image archive. Positive callback output cannot bypass independent final driver cleanup.

Every admitted container belongs to a fresh whole worker parent; exact daemon/worker birth-bound shutdown barrier handles unacknowledged or late containers on failure. Immediate failed-CLI cancellation precedes that barrier and does not itself prove daemon cleanup.

Driver records cleanup failures and requires positive durable final disposition; wrapper records exact child domain identities. Independent postflight current domain/socket/protected-container inventory is still necessary, including outer timeout failures.

Existing audit independently checks counters, output verification and immutable binding; this diagnostic deliberately emits a separate non-score schema and cannot satisfy official evidence audit or measurement gates.

Profile instrumentation modifies entrypoint only and reports explanatory function/import timings. Those timings include profiler overhead and its process CPU excludes interpreter startup; no correction or comparative speedup is established.
scope: Exact fixed empty-worker control and in-container importtime/cProfile explanatory probe only. No adoption, score, production activation or native execution acceptance.
